Chapter 1224 - 33: The Fate Of Shadow Demon And Nine Phoenix (Request For Subscription)_2

Chapter 1224: Chapter 33: The Fate of Shadow Demon and Nine Phoenix (Request for Subscription)_2

Of course, these shortcomings are not fatal, but they do exist. A million Cosmic Eras, tens of millions of Cosmic Era could not influence the operation of the Chaos Void, but when the timeline is lengthened by billions of times, little by little, the influence will gradually increase, eventually even pushing the entire Chaos Void into the Great Destruction.

Therefore.

In order to maintain the eternal operation of the Chaos Void, the thirteenth-level temporal beings stepped in to create some special locations, suppressing them at those key nodes to eliminate potential dangers.

This act benefits not only the Chaos Void but also the thirteenth-level temporal beings, as it elevates certain aspects of their foundation.

"No wonder, in the future timeline that I viewed using the Sky Void Tripod, the moment a special location was completely destroyed, a temporal being immediately descended..."

Lin Yuan thought to himself. In fact, normal strong individuals, even Invincible Great Saints, cannot shake those special locations. Beings below the thirteenth level cannot destroy them, even if they wish to.

However, Lin Yuan... with his terrifying power, coupled with the activation of the thirteenth-level weapon Sky Void Tripod, the released power was unimaginable, and that special location was completely destroyed in an instant.

"But from this perspective, the thirteenth level is not invincible either. At least the future timelines they see are not comprehensive. If they truly saw through all timelines, then I wouldn’t have had the opportunity to destroy that special location."

Lin Yuan thought silently in his heart.

Every moment, countless timelines emerge. The thirteenth-level temporal beings can only view part of these timelines. Perhaps the thirteenth-level temporal being behind that special location did not see the timeline in which Lin Yuan destroyed it.

"My inner universe is modeled after the Chaos Void. The hidden flaws and defects of the Chaos Void should also exist in my inner universe. Integrating the root objects and establishing a smaller special location would indeed greatly benefit the inner universe."

Lin Yuan’s thoughts spread out. The red-dressed girl told him to integrate the root objects, which was indeed not wrong.

...

"Let’s go out for a walk."

After carefully feeling the changes within himself, Lin Yuan slowly stood up.

Buzz!

In an instant, Lin Yuan left the Galaxy Chaos Continent, appearing thousands of Void Domains, tens of thousands of Void Domains away.

With another step forward, he left behind another few thousand, tens of thousands of Void Domains.

Even for a Chaos Great Saint, crossing a single Void Domain would take quite some time—several years, decades, centuries.

Crossing thousands, tens of thousands of Void Domains? The time needed is estimated to be measured in ten thousand years or a hundred thousand years.

The speed of a peerless Great Saint is a bit faster, but at most, they can only shorten the time by a few times.

But Lin Yuan, with each step, crosses thousands, tens of thousands of Void Domains, his speed unbelievably fast.

"Hmm?"

After taking three or four steps in succession, Lin Yuan suddenly stopped and looked in a certain direction.

At that location, Lin Yuan sensed two origins of causality related to himself.

...

"Nine Phoenix, if you want to die, can you not drag me down with you."

Amidst the fierce collision of black and red power, the Shadow Demon Great Saint angrily looked at the Nine Phoenix Great Saint who was entangling him.

Ever since the Galactic Great Saint of the Xuanhuang Universe killed their main combat bodies, the Shadow Demon Great Saint realized that the Galactic Great Saint was very displeased with him.

To be precise, he was displeased with both him and Nine Phoenix. Otherwise, why not accept the conditions they proposed and directly kill them?

Although he didn’t know the reason, angering a powerhouse like the Galactic Great Saint made the Shadow Demon Great Saint very apprehensive.

However, at this moment, the Nine Phoenix Great Saint recklessly continued to entangle him, even actively releasing his aura.

From that moment on, the Shadow Demon Great Saint realized that the Nine Phoenix Great Saint was courting death, trying to actively draw the attention of the Galactic Great Saint and thus provoke pursuit.

Because of this.

The Shadow Demon Great Saint chose to flee far from the nearby Void Domain of the Xuanhuang Universe. Over the years, the Shadow Demon Great Saint used some temporal vortexes in the Chaos Void to temporarily cross large tracts of the Void Domain, and is now nearly ten thousand Void Domains away from the Xuanhuang Universe.

Only after reaching this point did he feel a sense of security in his heart.

At such a great distance of nearly ten thousand Void Domains, even a Chaos Great Saint or a peerless Great Saint would need to spend considerable time to traverse it.

"Nine Phoenix, I know you want to draw the Galactic Great Saint, but it’s obvious the Galactic Great Saint hasn’t come after us," said the Shadow Demon Great Saint.

"Whether the Galactic Great Saint chases or not, I will continue to entangle you," the Nine Phoenix Great Saint said with determination.

Previously, outside that Xuanhuang Universe, he saw the hope of stepping into the thirteenth level. The Nine Phoenix Great Saint chose to cease hostilities with the Shadow Demon Great Saint. After all, once he steps into the thirteenth level, his brothers, sisters, and many clansmen could be resurrected.

Killing the Shadow Demon Great Saint cannot resurrect his clansmen, but stepping into the thirteenth level can.

After weighing the options, the Nine Phoenix Great Saint devoted himself to the Xuanhuang Universe.

"It’s pointless," the Shadow Demon Great Saint coldly looked at the Nine Phoenix Great Saint. "I am a Great Saint, and you are a Great Saint too. What can you achieve by entangling me? Even if as strong as the Galactic Great Saint, at best, he can only kill my main combat body. It’s impossible to completely kill me."

Every Chaos Great Saint secretly arranges countless contingencies; completely killing a Chaos Great Saint is something even ordinary Invincible Great Saints cannot achieve.

The reason the Shadow Demon Great Saint was so apprehensive after sensing the hostility of the Galactic Great Saint was purely out of fear of becoming an outcast.

It’s true, the Galactic Great Saint cannot kill him but can make life extremely difficult for the Shadow Demon Great Saint.
